text:
marie_cs: Quick note—CoralNet onboarding shows a 17% tail latency increase since they shipped longer context for multi-turn support. Customer on Standard tier. Looking for a safe perf play to avoid renewal churn.
devon_sre: Can you share recent p50/p95 and median tokens?
marie_cs: p50=210ms -> 185ms last 7d, p95=920ms -> 1080ms, median tokens/request up 22%. Peak concurrency ~60. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/coralnet/overview
ashok_ml: Two low-risk options: 1) route short requests (<80 tokens) to redwood-lite; 2) try int4 quantized variant for generator route with a 3% canary and strict quality gating. Also enable adaptive prefix caching for repeated prefixes.
ashok_ml: Example routing rule we can push via console:
```
routes: [
  { name: "short-path", match: "tokens<80", model: "redwood-lite-v1" },
  { name: "gen-path-canary", match: "tokens>=80", model: "redwood-gen-int4-v1", canary: 3, fallback: "redwood-gen-v1" }
]
cache: { prefix_kv: "adaptive", ttl: 300 }
```
fiona_enablement: I can assemble a 50-sample prompt eval set that mirrors CoralNet's heavy-case. Recommend 48h canary, evaluate BLEU/QA passthrough and top diffs. If any >4% semantic drift, rollback.
marie_cs: Customer is ok with a short-window canary but asked to avoid their Monday 17:00 local peak.
devon_sre: Scheduling note: we'll run canary at 03:00 PT (10:00 UTC) to avoid peaks. Also we'll set auto-rollback trigger: p95 worsens by >8% or any increase in error-rate.
ashok_ml: Expected impact: int4 after warmup should cut token compute ~18-22% and p50 ~10% on long-gen paths. Short-path split should drop end-to-end latency for small prompts by ~30-40%. Quality risk low but we'll gate.
marie_cs: Please include unit-cost estimate in the customer note. I'll frame as conservative ~15% cost savings.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: job=canary-coralnet-6188881235, pct=3, model=redwood-gen-int4-v1, start=6188883000
devon_sre: Also enabling prefix cache on hot routes now to smooth bursts.
fiona_enablement: I'll run eval after 2h of canary traffic and post diffs here and to #eng-ml for review. If diffs exceed threshold, we abort and collect reproduction traces.
marie_cs: Great. After 48h, if metrics look good, plan scale to 20% then full. Scheduling a 30-min touch with CoralNet CSM + Eng next Thursday.
devon_sre: I'll attach monitoring dashboard and set alert for >5% cost variance.
marie_cs: Thanks team. Keeping customer expectations low and offering rollback window.
